faqs.question: What is Individual Health Insurance?
faqs.answer: Individual Health Insurance provides coverage for a single person under one policy.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade my coverage later?
faqs.answer: Yes, most insurers allow coverage upgrades during renewal.

faqs.question: Does it cover hospitalization?
faqs.answer: Yes, hospitalization expenses are generally covered as per policy terms.

faqs.question: Is Individual Insurance better than Family Floater?
faqs.answer: It depends on your needs. Individual plans are ideal for personal coverage, while Family Floaters cover multiple family members.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered?
faqs.answer: Usually after the waiting period specified in the policy.
